title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 501 North Main Street in Florence, Arizona, as the "Adolfo 'Harpo' Celaya Post Office".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 501 North Main Street in Florence, Arizona, as the "Adolfo 'Harpo' Celaya Post Office."

summary.headline: Names a post office in Florence, Arizona, after Adolfo "Harpo" Celaya.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 501 North Main Street in Florence, Arizona, as the "Adolfo 'Harpo' Celaya Post Office." It is a naming change only. It does not change postal services, hours, staffing, or mail rules.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 16, 2016.
